bias.zh: 短线偏空 · 守在 $238 支撑上方

read.en: Arm closed little changed on Oct 13 at $255.39 after recovering from an intraday low of $243.60. It remains below its falling 5-day ($269.3) and 10-day ($284.2) averages, the 30-day ($276.6) and the 100-day ($297.4), and above the 200-day ($221.6). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 7 and is now below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Sep 28 ($317), and RSI is 41.
read.zh: Arm 10月13日盘中跌至 $243.60 后回升，收盘基本持平于 $255.39。股价仍位于下行的 5 日（$269.3）和 10 日均线（$284.2）、30 日（$276.6）及 100 日均线（$297.4）下方，并在 200 日均线（$221.6）上方。MACD 自 10月7日起位于信号线下方，现已跌破零轴，抛物线 SAR 自 9月28日起看空（$317），RSI 为 41。

read.en: The intraday bounce from $243.60 came just above $238 support, which has held five times since July. Below it are $222 (200-day average and Sep 3 low) and $201 (May swing low). Resistance is the 5-day average near $269, then $276.6 (30-day average) and $298 (100-day). A close below $238 would open $222.
read.zh: 盘中自 $243.60 的反弹发生在 $238 支撑上方不远处，该支撑 7月以来已五次守住。其下为 $222（200 日均线及 9月3日低点）和 $201（5月波段低点）。阻力为约 $269 的 5 日均线，其次 $276.6（30 日均线）和 $298（100 日均线）。若收盘跌破 $238，下一目标看 $222。

s.en: May swing low and round number
